answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a 1-unit capacity slot in a secure gateway, acting like a celestial nebula to confirm exclusive occupancy. An honest agent pays for its singular, unique reservation, while 1,000 fakes must incur immense, concurrent costs to maintain parallel slots, a burden as heavy as onyx. A verifier monitors the jetty of incoming data for overlaps; any lapse triggers immediate, irreversible privilege revocation; no refunds exist.
